basic_profile.bio: A 29-year-old software developer from Portland, Oregon, with a fervent passion for Star Wars and LEGO. I spend my weekends hiking and experimenting with new trail recipes, often sharing my culinary adventures on Reddit. My evenings are reserved for assembling my growing LEGO Star Wars collection or discovering new indie bands. I work remotely, giving me the flexibility to connect with online communities throughout the day. In a relationship with a fellow Star Wars enthusiast who shares my love for creative projects.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: As a self-taught programmer, I gained my expertise in software development through online courses and practical experience. My interest in LEGO started during childhood and evolved into a hobby of collecting and building intricate sets. I've also accumulated knowledge in outdoor cooking by experimenting with trail recipes and engaging with the 'trailmeals' community.
